sources.quote: 112 Piscium, also named Zibbatu, is a star 103.7 light-years away in the constellation Pisces.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 3.838 times the Sun's luminosity at 6,136 K, so 1.736 solar radii.
